rows.label: Aya
rows.note: a starting budget; carries between rotations

conditions: Saryn Prime is vaulted. Her relics do not return to normal mission drop tables during Prime Resurgence; Varzia sells them only while Saryn is in the active rotation.
Deimos level 40-60 final-stage bounty has a 43.48% Aya chance; stages 2-3 have 28.57%. Finish bonus objectives for a second final reward roll.
Avoid Deimos level 25-30 bounties: their Aya chance is only 3.85-5%. Steel Path bounty Aya rates are the same.
bonuses: Run Deimos solo: bounty objectives scale with squad size but Aya odds do not.
Use Cetus level 40-60 with a group if you prefer it; avoid Fortuna for dedicated Aya farming.

disclosures.title: the rotation is the real gate
disclosures.body: The researched rotation is Banshee/Mirage Prime through 2026-10-01, so Saryn relics are not currently for sale. Prime Resurgence changes every 28 days; check Varzia's live stock before spending Aya.

rows.note: Neo S13 in Saryn/Valkyr; Lith S17 in Nidus/Saryn
rows.alt: use matching relics already owned or buy them from players

conditions: The exact relics depend on which Saryn pairing returns. Confirm the stock and part rewards in Varzia's shop before buying.
Varzia is also available from the Prime Resurgence Market tab or the Orbiter Relic Segment.
Aya is untradeable, but purchased relics are tradeable and never expire.
bonuses: A friend can spend their Aya on tradeable relics for you.
If farming Aya is not worth the time, buying the tradeable set is often cheapest while Saryn is active.

rows.label: Saryn Prime Systems
rows.note: Common in the listed Resurgence relics; run Intact

conditions: Refine the Chassis relic to Radiant: a 2% Rare becomes 10% for 100 Void Traces. Four matching Radiants have a 34.39% chance to show at least one Rare reward.
Do not refine relics sought only for Common parts: Radiant lowers a Common reward from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Every player must collect 10 Reactant before extraction to open their relic.
bonuses: Host or join an exact-relic radshare in Recruitment chat or the Vaulted Relic Community Discord; solo Radiant averages ten Chassis attempts.
Only one reward may be selected per fissure. If one relic holds two wanted parts, keep cracking it until both are secured.
Varzia sells 5 Void Traces for 1 Aya when traces, rather than relics, become the limiting resource.

disclosures.title: avoid wasting rare rolls
disclosures.body: A four-player radshare is best when everyone needs the Chassis or can use its value. If only one player needs it, coordinate fewer Radiants per run so duplicate Rare rewards are less likely to be wasted.

conditions: Components build in parallel. Keep a free Warframe slot for the final claim.
